# Lintel, vendor copy

Unminified adapted source for the `studio-practice` edition (served copy: `public/templates/studio-practice/`). Same files, without the generated `source.zip` and `plotform-preview.jpg`.

- `upstream-astrowind-14e1a691.zip`: the pinned AstroWind source this edition adapts (MIT, https://github.com/onwidget/astrowind at 14e1a691f80548dcc36370847b1a02c0d0b12821), archived without `node_modules`.
- `VENDOR-NOTES.md`: what was reused from AstroWind and what was authored, dated 2026-09-17.
- `SOURCE.json` and `licenses/IMAGE-SOURCES.md`: per-image provenance.

No build step: the HTML, CSS and JavaScript are the deliverable. To rebuild `source.zip`, zip this folder's contents (minus this README and the upstream archive).
